title: Climbing toward the Divide
text: Interstate 40 climbs about a thousand feet as it crosses McKinley County from the Arizona line. Near the state line, the road sits at roughly 6,200 feet. At the Continental Divide at Campbell Pass, it reaches 7,275 feet.
